mapper.select: SELECT ut.tenant_id FROM sys_user_tenant ut INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = ut.tenant_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 0 AND (t.expire_time IS NULL OR t.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} AND ut.deleted = 0

SELECT t.id, t.tenant_code, t.company_name FROM sys_user_tenant ut INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = ut.tenant_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 0 AND (t.expire_time IS NULL OR t.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} AND ut.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.company_name, t.id
